purpose: Validate the frozen direct-versus-image mean offset and accuracy-1 versus pooled-2-5 observation scales using only actual observation metadata and synthetic log-scale measurements before real count magnitudes are opened.

simulation.rationale: Synthetic scales represent a moderate method effect and multiplicative measurement noise. They are recovery targets, not claims about the real data-generating values.

estimator.method_offset: For each site x species x season containing both direct and image-based records, compute mean(image log-observation) - mean(direct log-observation); estimate delta_image as the unweighted mean across mixed groups.
estimator.unknown_vantage: Exclude unknown-vantage records from method-offset and accuracy-scale calibration. Their primary-model treatment remains the frozen Gate 2B rule with a mandatory exclusion sensitivity.
estimator.accuracy_scales: After subtracting the estimated image offset, within each site x species x season and collapsed accuracy group, use only groups with >=2 known-vantage observations. Pool within-group sums of squares over residual degrees of freedom to estimate sigma for accuracy 1 and pooled 2-5.
estimator.singleton_rule: Singleton groups contribute no variance information.

diagnostics: report mixed direct-image group counts overall and by species
report repeated groups and residual degrees of freedom for each collapsed accuracy class
report species-specific offset recovery as a non-gating diagnostic while the primary offset is shared across species
boundary: Real count magnitudes are never read, summarized, transformed or modeled; count is used only as a non-missingness flag to reconstruct the frozen cohort.
The shared image offset is a cross-species observation parameter; ecological process effects remain species-specific.
If any primary recovery check fails, do not open real demographic count magnitudes and do not tune thresholds or simulation values post hoc. A new fallback observation-model contract is required.
